children: Nvidia Corp. NVDA, Financials, the semiconductor company at the center of the AI infrastructure boom, is in yet another argument about the direction in which the technology is moving.
Seeking Alpha said that President Donald Trump called up Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on stage unexpectedly and called AI a hoax. The comments are made at an unexpected time.

While industry leaders debate whether research should stall, AI companies are spending hundreds of billions of dollars on chips, data centers and power infrastructure. That tension important to Nvidia.
The firm has emerged as one of the greatest financial winners of the AI buildout, with its accelerators driving many of the biggest computing systems in the industry.
Thus any significant slowdown in investment will soon grab investor notice. Then there's the matter of political oversight.

Governments are already squabbling about AI legislation, energy needs, semiconductor exports and national security limits. Nvidia is at the center of many of those problems. One statement doesn't impact the company's huge order pipeline, shareholders.

But the conversation about AI is certainly evolving. Investors will now look to see if the political discussion remains hyperbole or starts to alter the policies and spending that support Nvidia's growth.

title: Trump stuns Nvidia's Jensen Huang with an unexpected AI remark
